title: Spending Alerts and Budget Controls on Hunter Green
summary: This document covers spending alerts and budget controls for Hunter Green: real-time alerts are enabled by default with a $100 threshold (alert when a single transaction is ≥ $100). It also explains a $2,000 spending limit buffer that may approve transactions even if available balance is temporarily insufficient, and how to customize alert types and notification delivery.
faqs: What are the default settings for Hunter Green spending alerts and their $100 threshold—when will I receive an alert?
How does the $2,000 spending limit buffer work if my available balance is temporarily insufficient?
Can I adjust the alert threshold above or below $100 to match my typical transaction sizes?
How can I enable alerts for card-present, online, and/or international transactions?
How do I choose push vs. email delivery preferences for spending alerts?
What should I do to review buffered transactions so my balance matches expected activity?
